editorial:
Arkin is an ex-con trying to fix his life, but money trouble pulls him back into crime. He plans a quick heist at his boss’s country home, only to find another killer has already turned the place into a nightmare of traps. The movie throws you into a tense game of hide-and-seek, where every hallway feels dangerous and every second counts. You follow Arkin as he tries to survive and maybe save the family caught in the middle.

The scares come from sharp pacing, nasty traps, and a masked villain who feels relentless. The acting keeps you invested, especially when Arkin has to make hard choices. Some moments are very gory, and the story can feel thin between shocks, so sensitive viewers should be careful. If you enjoy brutal home-invasion thrillers, this one delivers. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: Arkin finally escapes the trapped house, but his freedom does not last. He is hit by a car and wakes up in an ambulance. The Collector has already killed the paramedics and is riding with him. The killer injects Arkin, leaving him helpless as the ambulance drives away. The final twist shows the Collector has won, and Arkin is now his prisoner.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves brutal home-invasion thrillers.
